stage1_placebo_block: last 100 eligible pre-event trading dates (already consumed by the failed first rescue)
stage2_placebo_block: the immediately preceding 100 eligible pre-event trading dates, i.e. eligible_event_dates[-200:-100]
stage2_calibration: first 50 dates of the stage2 block, paired chronologically into 25 non-overlapping two-day pseudo-events
stage2_validation: last 50 dates of the stage2 block, paired chronologically into 25 non-overlapping two-day pseudo-events; never used for candidate selection
expected_return_estimation: for every pseudo-event and every candidate, exact 200 benchmark-factor return dates strictly preceding the pseudo-event
primary_exposure_preference: frontier_ai_exposure_z when its pre-event nonzero-share gate remains >=0.25
primary_ai_exposure_z otherwise or only after all frontier candidates fail calibration

cross_sectional_controls.hierarchical_industry_cell_rule: use SIC4 when that exact SIC has >=20 firms in the pseudo-event sample; otherwise SIC3 when its prefix has >=20 firms; otherwise SIC2

wls_rule: inverse selected-model residual variance with sigma clipped to positive-sigma p10/p90; zero/non-finite sigma receives p90 sigma before inversion (lowest allowed precision weight)
selection_rule: within the frozen candidate order and exposure preference, select the first candidate with calibration MDE80 <=0.45pp; test exactly that candidate once on untouched validation; publish only if validation MDE80 <=0.50pp
failure_rule: if no candidate passes calibration or the selected candidate fails validation, publish nothing, mutate no paper state, keep PRE_FREEZE_AUDIT pending, and keep Astra outcomes locked
